name: book_appointment
description: Request a racket demo or restringing appointment. Two steps: first call with confirmed=false; the response returns error code confirmation_required with details.summary. Read that summary to the shopper word for word. Only after they clearly say yes, call again with identical details and confirmed=true. A demo also requires the racket to be in stock at that store.

service_type.description: demo = try a racket in store; restring = restringing service.

product_id.description: Racket id from search_rackets. Required for demos; omit for restringing unless the shopper names a catalog racket.

customer_name.description: Shopper's name as they gave it.

phone.description: Shopper's phone number with 10-15 digits, e.g. 415-555-0134.

preferred_time.description: Requested local store time in ISO 8601 without a timezone, e.g. 2026-11-07T15:00. Must be in the future.

notes.description: Optional extra details, e.g. string type or tension.

confirmed.description: false on the first call. true ONLY after the shopper explicitly confirmed the summary you read back.
